newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila okays uranium sale to Siemens unit.
newsitem.headline: Manila okays uranium sale to Siemens unit.

text.p: The Philippine's Committee on Privatisation (COP) has approved the start of negotiations between National Power Corp (Napocor) for the sale of uranium fuel to a unit of Siemens AG, Napocor said on Tuesday.
In a letter to Napocor president Guido Delgado, the Cabinet-level COP said it has voted in favor of a proposed negotiated sale of the uranium fuel to Siemens Power Corp.
Siemens was one of two companies which submitted a bid in June to buy Napocor's unused nuclear fuel. Both firms submitted lower bids than the indicative price set at $32.64 million.
Napocor had the choice to conduct new bidding or negotiate with the highest bidder.

The uranium was supposed to be used by Napocor for the country's first nuclear power plant built in the 1980's, a 620-megawatt facility in Bataan, north of Manila, but which was eventually mothballed.
